Estimation of Oxygen Supply Rate (OSR) through the gas membrane

OSR through the membrane was evaluated at different air pressures of 14, 28 and 41 kPa. A cylindrical vessel similar in design and volume to the microaerobic zone of the AMFB reactor was filled with distilled water that had been deoxygenated by continuous sparging of N2 gas (99%). A DO meter was used for continuous monitoring of dissolved oxygen in the test vessel. Membrane aeration was initiated once a DO of < 0.1 mg/L was reached. The change in DO concentration with active membrane aeration was monitored with the DO meter and used for estimation of OSR according to equations (1) and (3) below [1, 2].
